newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KIRSTEN EARNS RECALL BY GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KIRSTEN EARNS RECALL BY GERMANY.

text.p: Germany have recalled Bayer Leverkusen striker Ulf Kirsten to their squad for a World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland on November 9.

Kirsten, a former East German international, was omitted from the squad which won the European championship in June but has been a key figure in a revitalised Leverkusen side this season, with seven Bundesliga goals.
German coach Berti Vogts on Tuesday named 26 players for the group nine match at Nuremberg's Frankenstadion. The number will be reduced after the weekend Bundesliga programme.
He had hoped to include Karlsruhe's South African striker Sean Dundee but an application for German citizenship has not yet been processed.
Goalkeepers - Oliver Kahn, Andreas Koepke, Oliver Reck.
Defenders - Markus Babbel, Thomas Helmer, Juergen Kohler, Stephan Passlack, Stefan Reuter, Thomas Schneider.
Midfielders - Mario Basler, Marco Bode, Dieter Eilts, Thomas Haessler, Joerg Heinrich, Andreas Moeller, Mehmet Scholl, Thomas Strunz, Michael Tarnat, Jens Todt, Dariusz Wosz.
Forwards - Oliver Bierhoff, Fredi Bobic, Heiko Herrlich, Ulf Kirsten, Juergen Klinsmann, Stefan Kuntz.
